title: Sunday · the tavern roof
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Third kept Sunday. The wash is learning. The tin roof in rain, the tavern, the alley. Silent.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the garage and the tavern from the alley in rain, watercolor. Rust on the corrugated tin, done right for the first time — orange bleeding into gray on purpose.

image.prompt: a cedar-shingle garage and the back of a tavern seen from a gravel alley in rain, watercolor, the rust on the corrugated tin roof bleeding orange into gray on purpose, ink under it

panels.name: The alley

panels.composition: Tier 2: the casement window from outside, lamplight inside, a shape at the table. The window's yellow the only warm note.

image.prompt: a small casement window seen from a rainy alley with warm lamplight inside and the shape of someone at a table, the only warm color in a gray watercolor

panels.name: The window

panels.composition: Tier 3: the alley empty, the rain, the neon of the tavern's beer sign reflected in a puddle. Controlled now.

image.prompt: an empty gravel alley in rain with a tavern's beer-sign neon reflected in a puddle, controlled watercolor washes, no words

panels.name: The puddle

art.palette: gray, rust orange, one yellow window

notes: Third kept Sunday of the bad-color spring. The rust is the first thing the color gets right.
